guarantee.accelerated: blocking lookahead: order is a pure function of the source timeline under ANY scheduling
guarantee.interface: frozen public DeviceSource only (no private fields)
guarantee.limitation: the frozen DeviceSource interface offers no watermark/heartbeat; a future DeviceSource contract version should add one
guarantee.live_speed: bounded settle (8 loop turns); a slower event view yields a loud MuxOrderError (session FAILED), never a silently different order
guarantee.stop_semantics: manual stop stops consuming at the next record; run-ahead source events the product never reached are discarded (counted); a source mid-outage is left in its own link state for the owner to disconnect
